note: SayCan (Do As I Can, Not As I Say): LLM proposes steps, skill affordance/value functions ground feasibility; robot is the LLM's hands and eyes.
Inner Monologue: closed-loop language feedback (success detection, scene description, human interaction) significantly improves high-level instruction completion.
Voyager repo (~7.3k stars, MIT): automatic curriculum, ever-growing executable-code skill library, iterative prompting; first LLM-powered embodied lifelong learning agent in Minecraft.
SwiftSage (NeurIPS 2023 spotlight): dual-system agent — small-LM System 1 acting + large-LLM System 2 planning, heuristic integration; beats SayCan/ReAct/Reflexion on 30 ScienceWorld tasks.
Krafton PUBG Ally: System 1 behavior tree at game tick rate + System 2 language model; 'Reflex-level actions never have to wait for the model'; boundary definition was the hardest part.
